title: Weighted Boxes Fusion: Ensembling Boxes for Object Detection Models
why_relevant: Directly supports detector ensembling for better mAP without external data.
extracted_technique: Weighted Boxes Fusion (WBF) to merge multi-model box predictions using confidence-weighted averaging instead of NMS.
takeaway: WBF is a lightweight post-processing ensemble method that often improves localization and recall compared to selecting a single model or using NMS-only merging.

title: Focal Loss for Dense Object Detection
why_relevant: Helps train detection/classification components under severe class imbalance (relevant for rare positives and dense negatives).
extracted_technique: Focal loss to down-weight easy negatives and focus learning on hard examples; can be used for classification head or imbalance-aware training.
takeaway: Focal loss is a standard, well-tested way to stabilize learning when positives are rare; it’s often preferable to naive reweighting alone.

title: Ultralytics YOLO Documentation
why_relevant: Provides a practical, reproducible YOLO-style training/inference loop suitable for GPU training from scratch on custom YOLO-format datasets.
extracted_technique: YOLO-style detector training with augmentations, multi-scale, mixed precision, and exportable inference; supports custom datasets in YOLO label format.
takeaway: Ultralytics’ training mode is a pragmatic way to implement detector training + inference quickly; for rule compliance, initialize from scratch and train only on competition data.

title: Mean Average Precision (mAP) Glossary (Ultralytics)
why_relevant: Clarifies how mAP@[0.5:0.95] is computed and what it represents, matching the competition’s detection component.
extracted_technique: COCO-style mAP computed across multiple IoU thresholds (0.50 to 0.95) and averaged, used for detector model selection.
takeaway: mAP@[0.5:0.95] rewards both localization quality and confidence ranking; tuning confidence/NMS/WBF affects the metric materially.
